journey.d: 5th ky bad school dekh rhy thy kha lagna hy phir  Aik din mujhy bazar ka keh kr Abu g M.C main ly aye or poocha english medium krni hy ya Urdu waha main heran phir koi option na milty huye mainy English medium keh diya phir Head master ny Zubair sahib ko call lgai or wo mujhy lyny ky liye office main aye main un ky sath class main gya waha class almost full thi pehly din mujhy sab ky chehry aik jaisy lgy or bs mainy is trga apna pehla din guzara . Agy ni yad ky kesy or kitny dino ky bad main un 5 larko ky sath beth gya na janty huye ky ye hi ab akhir tak mery sath chly gy or ye life ko memorable bnaye gy . Phir waha meri dosti tum sy hui or group ky baqi larko sy hui . And aj bhi jab bhi main un sy milta hu wo sab pehly ki trha mehsus hony lgata hy .

Har din ab hum jo yad krty hain wo kya hi khubsurat memories bn kr samny ati hain kabhi hum un sy hansty hain kabhi us pr emotional hoty hoty hain or kabhi sochty hain ky ye kash na krty ya aisa na hota .. But it always make us happy

Kitny saal guzr gye almost 9 years yani apny childhood sy ly kr jawan hoty tk sari zindagi sath guzari hy .. or yaha tk zindagi bht hi khubsurat guzri hy . Ab agy ka koi idea ni kesi ho gi kesy guzry gi .. No words to describe

gifts.d: Mainy bht logo Sy suna Hy trust or loyalty ki batein krty huye KY hmain koi aisa mily but mainy ni kabhi aisa Socha it's because I found you 🥺💖

Har din ab hum jo yad krty hain wo kya hi khubsurat memories bn kr samny ati hain kabhi hum un sy hansty hain kabhi us pr emotional hoty hoty hain or kabhi sochty hain ky ye kash na krty ya aisa na hota .. But it always make us happy 🥺💕
Pta ni is main Kya likhu but itna kehna Hy KY mainy aj tak Tum Sy Kuch ni chupaya or bilkul same tumhary samny hota hu . Or  hmaisha Tumhain Bhi aisa hi paya Hy 💖😌
Mainy kabhi tum logo KY Sath good ya bad company KY bary main ni Socha . Main jab Bhi Tum logo KY Sath hota hu us moment ko full enjoy krta hu . Thanks 😊❣️
Thanks for everything you have done for me . Thanks to make my life meaningful. Thanks for everything 💖✨

Yar friends aisa word Hy shayad koi samajh na sky . Friends wo ni Jo sirf zaroorat main tumhary Sath hoty hain . Friends to wo Hain Jo har trha Sy tumhary Sath ho or isi Sy life khubsurat bnti hy . I miss you all 💝🥺
Abdul Hayyee 
Hashaam
Haseeb 
Rehan
Muneeb

wishes.m: I hope life gives you everything you've ever dreamed of. You deserve more happiness than words can ever express. ✨
May Allah protect your smile and heal every pain you hide. May your future be more beautiful than you imagine. 🫂
May life change in a thousand ways, but may we always have beautiful memories to look back on and smile about. 🫶

letter.body:
5th ky bad sab ny kha isy is school main bhejna hy ya us school main . Meri mama ny kha M.C ni bhejna waha larai waghera bht hoti hy lekin mery Papa kehty isy M.C hi lgana hy . Aik din mujhy bazar ka keh kr Abu g M.C main ly aye or poocha english medium krni hy ya Urdu waha main heran phir koi option na milty huye mainy English medium keh diya phir Head master ny Zubair sahib ko call lgai or wo mujhy lyny ky liye office main aye main un ky sath class main gya waha class almost full thi pehly din mujhy sab ky chehry aik jaisy lgy or bs mainy is trga apna pehla din guzara . Agy ni yad ky kesy or kitny dino ky bad main un 5 larko ky sath beth gya na janty huye ky ye hi ab akhir tak mery sath chly gy or ye life ko memorable bnaye gy . Phir waha meri dosti tum sy hui or group ky baqi larko sy hui . And aj bhi jab bhi main un sy milta hu wo sab pehly ki trha mehsus hony lgata hy ... Acha phir kuch zyada yad ni lekin mujhy ye yad hy tumhari or meri school main anban chati rehti thi tum aisi waisi harktein krty thy or mujhy ajeeb lagta tha . yad hy aj bhi hum ground main gye thy frisbee khelny ky liye or tum waha mujhy ring pehnany ky liye a gye thy us waqt to mujhy bht gussa aya tha lekin ab hasta bhi hu yr kesi harktain thi yr ... but isi trha time guzrta rha or hmari 8th ho gai phir kisi ny section Qadeer rskh liya to kisi ny Quaid hi rkha . Tumny apny papa ky kehny pr apni achi teleem ky liye Superior school rakh liya  or yaha sy safr different huva or aj tak ikathy beth kr ni prha ... Bs ab main zyada deep ni jana chahta lekin han mainy logo sy suna tha ky log muhabbat main khud ko barbad kr dety hain lekin mainy aik larka dekha hy jis ny Babar ky peechy apna aik saal repeat kiya .. han babar to abhi bhi uski nazro main waisa hi hy lekin ab usy ye pta chal gya hy ky muhabbat or zindagi ko aik sath kesy ly kr chalna hy ... Ab agy ka pta ni likhny ki mujh main himmat ni ho ri lekin ye pta hy ky laat year sy ab tak jitni hum ny online chat ki hy shayad hi main zindagi main kru ga lekin ni ni kr skta main ab to kya yr chat krny ka dil ni krta ...
Bs yr aik cheez hy tu zindagi main kabhi kahi bhi kisi bhi mushkil main ho to mujhy na bhulna . I am always with you . 
Meri dua hy Allah tumhain itna kamyab kry itna kamyab kry ky tum apni har khwahish or apny har khwab ko poora hota dekh sky .
Always be happy 😉and take care .
Allah Hafiz.🥺🤲💖
And one last thing " Yad kru ga koi Abdul Hayyee hunda c "🙂
